translations.note: The preceding 'in' is cut off. The full clause reads: '(Bacchic apples) once prevailed so much in love affairs that crowns made of them were placed on statues of Bacchus'.
translations.text: love affairs prevailed, that crowns made from them were placed on statues of Bacchus

translations.note: A fragment. In context: 'the East Indians use cubebs steeped in wine to arouse lust, and the Africans the root Surax'.
translations.text: for arousing lust, and
